brief:
Major General Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, threatened Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, vowing that Iran "will send him to hell," Shehab Wire reported. Rezaei said Netanyahu's strategic decisions and military errors have accelerated what he framed as Israel's imminent collapse.

The warning signals a hardening of rhetoric from Tehran's top security apparatus toward Israeli leadership. Rezaei's comments reflect deepening hostilities between Iran and Israel as regional tensions continue to mount over military operations and diplomatic disputes across the Middle East.
